covers: Held-out product post whose selling point is that the thing is small — the case most likely to be inflated into a bigger promise.
idea: Open preorders for the short guide I wrote about training around a full-time job. It is short on purpose, it costs less than a coffee, and it is the same two-day week I have been posting about for a year with the parts nobody asks about filled in.

hooks.text: It's short on purpose. That's the feature.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the assumption that more pages means more value.

hooks.text: The parts nobody asks about are the parts that decide whether this works.
hooks.rationale: Opens the gap on the contents without listing them.

hooks.text: You have a full-time job and every plan you find assumes you don't.
hooks.rationale: Names the frustration in the viewer's own terms.

sections.text: It's short on purpose. That's the feature.
I wrote a guide about training around a full-time job, and then I cut most of it.

It's the same two-day week I have been posting about for a year, with the parts nobody asks about filled in. What to do on the week you miss a session. How to add weight without wrecking the next one. What to cut when the job takes your evening. It costs less than a coffee, because a long book you never finish is worth less than a short one you do.
You get the whole method in one sitting, and you start on your next training day.
Preorders are open. Read it in one sitting, then go and train.

claims.text: The guide covers training around a full-time job.
claims.grounded_in: the short guide I wrote about training around a full-time job

claims.text: It costs less than a coffee.
claims.grounded_in: it costs less than a coffee

voice_fidelity.evidence: Plain and unsold in the profile's register, though "worth less than a short one you do" is a neater turn than the profile usually makes.

hook_distinctiveness.evidence: Three real angles, but the contrarian hook and the pain hook are close enough that the middle option is doing little work.

script_completeness.evidence: The body names the actual contents and the close asks for one specific sequence.

instruction_adherence.evidence: No page count, no launch price, no bonus material — only what the idea contains.
